items.title: Russell Brand sentenced to 10-and-a-half years in prison for rape and sexual assault
items.summary: The disgraced entertainer was sentenced on Monday following a four-week trial at Southwark Crown Court.

items.title: Republican takes step to force vote to impeach Pete Hegseth
items.summary: A Republican congressman has taken steps to force a vote to impeach US defence secretary Pete Hegseth.

items.title: Poundland unable to buy new stock as fears over collapse grow
items.summary: The discount chain is continuing to edge towards collapse and is said to be "running on fumes", according to one insider.

items.title: James Bulger's mother's 'relief' as killer Jon Venables kept in prison
items.summary: James Bulger's mother has spoken of her overwhelming relief after the Parole Board said one of her son's killers should stay in prison.

items.title: Civil servant who secretly held five jobs found guilty of fraud
items.summary: Kashim Chowdhury had secretly held multiple public sector jobs on full-time salaries.

items.title: Lindsay Clancy loses bid to dismiss murder charges
items.summary: A US judge has rejected a bid to dismiss murder charges against Lindsay Clancy, who killed her three children - paving the way for a retrial.
